description: This file defines a C# class 'VariableDefinition' which models a TypeScript variable or property in source code, including metadata such as name, type, initializer, access modifiers, and other attributes.

classes.name: VariableDefinition
classes.description: Represents a TypeScript class property/field (variable definition) with various attributes like name, type, initializer, access modifier, and modifiers like readonly/static.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the variable definition, including modifiers, name, type, and initializer.
